project_execution: Only absolute forms whose paired -u subject form is already explicitly reviewed in GRAM-NGENDER-002/006 are executable.
note: A noun focused by baa/ayaa does not keep the ordinary nominative -u subject form. For example, reviewed wiilku pairs to focused-subject wiilka, and gabadhu pairs to gabadha. No unseen noun pair is generated.

project_execution: Only exact reviewed affirmative simple-past finite surfaces are reinterpreted contextually. No restrictive person value is added to global morphology.
note: For a focused 3pl subject, the restrictive simple past uses the ordinary 3sg-masculine-shaped surface. Thus a reviewed focused plural can agree with yimid/cunay while ordinary non-focus 3pl still requires full forms such as yimaaddeen/cuneen.

project_execution: Regular short-a forms are built only from exact reviewed full finite paradigms and kept in a private focus-only index. Reviewed irregular present behavior is handled only where explicitly sourced. No reduced present surface is promoted to global morphology.
The reduced surface is derived only from exact reviewed affirmative full finite morphology; it remains contextual to focused-subject agreement and is absent from global finite morphology.
Only exact reviewed affirmative past-progressive finite surfaces are reinterpreted. No new past-progressive spelling is generated and excluded irregular lemmas are never inferred.

note: Only explicitly modeled affirmative restrictive paradigms are judged. Future, negative, habitual and other unmodeled focused-subject constructions remain unjudged unless exact sentence-level evidence licenses them independently.
